title: Fast from retaliation
summary: Forgiveness is a discipline that changes conduct. Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When resentment asks to be fed, keep the fast by withholding the rehearsed reply. Let one full breath and one full act of restraint answer first.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness is a discipline that changes conduct.
source.lifeApplication: When resentment rises, answer first with restraint instead of retaliation.

evidence.turn: Remember this: forgiveness, conduct, and contentment free the heart from fear.
